chapters.name: Irregular regions
intro: Blocks can be any shape now.
A slide still stops on the first square of a new block.

chapters.name: Walls
intro: Walls stop a slide on the square before them.
Use them to stop where you need to.

chapters.name: Sticky squares
intro: Sticky squares stop a slide the moment it enters them.
They can help you stop, or slow you down.
